posts.texte: GTA 6 is officially 1 Friday out from launch.

Xbox confirms the GTA 6 size is 209.86GB on Series X|S.

There are 3 separate versions of the game on PS5 and Xbox:

- Worldwide (US, EU, Middle East, Asia) all share the same data
- New Zealand and Australia (both share the same data)
- Japan (separate and the size is around 1GB
